source: Souviks catalogue product/engineering dimensions and standard-part geometric assumptions
purpose: Estimated net item weights plus single-unit packaging allowances for shipping; not manufacturer measured weights.

packaging.profile_note: Carton-cut-and-wrap for standard items; plastic-wrap-only for leaf springs. This is an estimated unit allowance, not measured carton tare or external parcel dimensions.

method: Calculate theoretical metal mass from item geometry where a complete or standardised shape is available. Solid shank/prism and standard fastener dimensions are explicit assumptions; estimates remain labelled estimated.
